dotnet.source_global_json_policy: Do not edit tracked global.json. The existing 10.0.100/latestFeature policy selects 10.0.403 from the isolated installation. Verify the actual selected SDK in every exact-revision worktree.

manual_dispatch_note: GitHub requires workflow_dispatch on the default branch. This native-only body replaces .github/workflows/ci-validation.yml in a two-file CI-only commit directly on its pinned source; the variant-specific native push trigger does not add a second full-validation workflow.

local_validation.checks: Parse YAML/JSON; compile embedded orchestration without running product code; run the embedded pure native-log validator fixtures and timeout abort fixture; parse PowerShell; verify exact source/run provenance, native-only phase graph, pinned actions, immediate upload globs and bounded deadlines.
local_validation.known_linter_catalog_mismatch: Unfiltered actionlint 1.7.12 rejects only ubuntu-26.04, which the current official GitHub standard/free runner reference lists without a preview marker. The narrow ignore handles this catalog drift; no workflow-expression or other lint diagnostic is ignored.
local_validation.product_executions: Not run locally: no product build/test, NativeAOT publish/run, benchmark or profiling is authorized by preparation of these four documents.
local_validation.ci_execution: Not run: preparation does not publish a branch, create a PR, dispatch Actions or alter credentials/repository policy.
local_validation.fixture_source: Embedded assess_native_publish and native_log_validator_selftests in the paired workflow; CI retains actual fixture results as evidence/native-log-validator-selftests.json.

native_log_validator_fixture_results.active_cli_exit_gate: passed: a failed/inconclusive/Not run active native phase exits1; intentionally reused Not run phases do not claim passed
native_log_validator_fixture_results.timeout_abort_fixture: passed: after a synthetic timeout, the next product phase was Not run and its callable was never invoked

static_results.actionlint: passed with sole documented Ubuntu26.04 catalog exception

local_validation.workflow_variant_equivalence: Identical implementation after substituting only variant labels, source SHA and prior-run URL; no broad substring replacement.

source.full_suite_execution_this_run: Not run: native-only revalidation, reused earlier exact-source evidence
source.push_resolution: Use the sole direct parent of the CI-only commit; it must equal this exact recorded_candidate_sha. Require the diff to contain exactly the two install_paths and no product files.
source.dispatch_resolution: The full source_sha input, CI-only direct parent and recorded_candidate_sha must match.

reused_evidence.reuse_policy: Every listed phase is Not run in this follow-up, never passed by inheritance. Keep earlier artifacts and statuses separately attributed to this exact source. Verify earlier run completion and each phase before treating reused evidence as complete.
reused_evidence.performance_policy: No repeated timings, numerical allowance, cherry-picking or new performance-acceptance claim. This follow-up changes the native IL-log phase boundary only.

native_validation.positive_publish_gate: Require completed publish exit0, the first standalone Generating native code marker, and zero warning/error IL diagnostics at or after that first marker, including across repeated markers. Preserve the entire pre-marker compiler/analyzer log and diagnostics without suppression.
native_validation.native_execution_gate: Require the actual published native executable to exist, record its SHA256 and toolchain, execute it directly, and require exit0. A clean log alone never proves the executable ran.
native_validation.negative_control: Unchanged exit/IL criteria: reflection-enabled publish must exit nonzero with genuine error IL2026/IL2070/IL2075/IL3050 after the first standalone Generating native code marker; pre-marker errors alone never validate this control.

known_original_validator_defect.cause: The previous validator searched the whole publish log and rejected compiler/analyzer warnings before native generation, preventing the native binary command.
known_original_validator_defect.correction_scope: Partition at the observed native-generation marker; preserve both phases and keep all other positive/negative/CLI exit gates.

timeouts.timeout_policy: Retain partial logs and process-tree/group cleanup attempts. Abort every later product phase after any timeout even if cleanup is uncertain. There are no timing phases in this mode. The bounded native-only step leaves always-upload time below the job deadline.

retention.upload: Immediate evidence/*.log, evidence/*.json and evidence/*.jsonl only. No recursive glob, worktree, build tree, Git metadata or CodeGraph index.
retention.partial_output: Native publish and native executable logs are written directly to the artifact staging directory before completion. Atomic JSON status files retain completed observations.
retention.worktrees: Do not delete or recycle an output directory during the job. Hosted VMs are ephemeral; only uploaded evidence survives VM decommissioning.
retention.failures: Retain every command, original publish log, pre-native analyzer diagnostics, post-marker native diagnostics, nonzero CLI result and timeout. No warning suppression or product-file change.
